result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major text rendering problem in the restaurant listing, and minor layout cutoff issues with horizontally scrollable content.

issues.description: Text rendering issue in 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' section - the text appears corrupted showing 'Drdellvery' instead of properly formatted delivery information
issues.suggestion: Fix text rendering/font display issue. Ensure text is properly aligned and formatted. The delivery time and category should be clearly separated and readable (likely should show '25-30 min delivery • Ramen')

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right side, making the restaurant name and details incomplete
issues.suggestion: Ensure all horizontally scrollable cards are fully visible or add proper visual indication that content is scrollable (e.g., overflow gradient)

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20% discount) is partially cut off at the bottom of the visible area
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing or provide clearer indication that there is more content below to scroll to
